rationale: CPRI has gapped up ~10.5% on no news catalyst and is trading at 97.2% of its intraday range, just $0.04 below the session high, with the broader market under significant pressure (SPY -1.26%, VIXY +6.72%). The stock is extended well above VWAP ($18.67) and the 9-EMA ($18.87), making a long entry at the top of range risky with limited upside to the high. A short against a stock showing this kind of relative strength in a down tape is equally dangerous — the momentum is clearly upward with 5.69x relative volume. No news context makes the catalyst unclear, and the risk/reward in either direction at this price level is unfavorable.
